ATTACK SQUADRON (VA) 165 CREWMEN LOAD ORDNANCE ABOARD AN A-6 INTRUDER ATTACK AIRCRAFT BEING PREPARED FOR LAUNCH FROM THE ATTACK AIRCRAFT CARRIER USS RANGER (CVA-61) TO CONDUCT AN AIR STRIKE OVER NORTH VIETNAM.  OFFICIAL U.S. NAVY PHOTOGRAPH BY PH1 DONALD F. GRANTHAM

title: An aerial view of the ships of Battle Force Zulu underway at the conclusion of Operation Desert Storm. The guided missile cruisers include the USS BUNKER HILL (CG-52), the USS NORMANDY (CG-60), and the USS LEYTE GULF (CG-55). Aircraft carriers include the USS MIDWAY (CV-41), the USS RANGER (CV-61), the USS AMERICA (CV-66) and the nuclear-powered aircraft carrier USS THEODORE ROOSEVELT (CVN-71)
note:
The original finding aid described this photograph as:

Subject Operation/Series: DESERT STORM

Country: Red Sea

Scene Camera Operator: PH1 Galen L. Walker
